NOWPayments verifies the payment on-chain and fires a webhook automatically. The product delivers before the buyer closes their wallet. content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

The reliance on Stripe-free infrastructure is a result of Venezuela's unique economic situation, where US sanctions have severely limited access to traditional payment processors like Stripe. This has led to the development of alternative solutions that leverage blockchain technology and cloud infrastructure to enable creators to accept cryptocurrency payments from international buyers. By using this infrastructure, creators can avoid the risks associated with traditional payment processors and connect directly with their global audience.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture of this Stripe-free infrastructure relies on the use of cloud infrastructure providers like Cloudflare, which offer a range of services that enable creators to host and manage their digital products. This includes services like Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, and Supabase for order storage. Additionally, NOWPayments is used for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification, which allows creators to accept a wide range of cryptocurrencies, including USDT on Tron, which settles in under 60 seconds for a fee under $0.10.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This Stripe-free infrastructure is built for digital creators in countries like Venezuela, Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, and others where access to traditional payment processors is restricted. It's a solution that provides creators with the tools and services they need to sell their digital products to international buyers, without relying on traditional payment processors that may be subject to US sanctions or restrictions.
The blockchain has no map of restricted countries — a wallet in Harare processes identically to one in Hamburg.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The components that make this Stripe-free infrastructure work together include GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. These components work together to enable creators to host, manage, and sell their digital products to international buyers, without relying on traditional payment processors.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this Stripe-free infrastructure today, creators can start by purchasing the Complete Builder Kit, which includes all 6 blueprints and 7 templates needed to build, deploy, and scale a sovereign digital commerce stack. This kit is available for instant download and includes everything needed to get started with accepting cryptocurrency payments from international buyers. Additionally, creators can start by setting up their hosting and backend logic using Cloudflare Pages and Workers, and then integrating NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The most practical path for creators in restricted countries starts with NOWPayments configured to receive USDT on Tron as the primary payment coin. USDT is a stable coin pegged to the US dollar — your revenue does not fluctuate with crypto market movements. Tron network fees are under $0.10, and settlement takes under 60 seconds. Once USDT arrives in your wallet, you convert to local currency through P2P exchanges — Binance P2P is available in most countries and supports naira, cedis, Kenyan shillings, and Pakistani rupees. The conversion takes 20 to 30 minutes on average and costs 2 to 5 percent.
Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, and Zimbabwe are operating sovereign stores with this infrastructure right now.

Creators in Nigeria, Ghana, Kenya, Pakistan, Bangladesh, Zimbabwe, and other restricted markets searching for international payment solutions are looking for the same thing: a way to receive USD-equivalent payments from global buyers without a Stripe or PayPal account. The Edge Commerce Stack at $197 is the complete answer — Cloudflare Pages, Workers, Supabase, and NOWPayments deployed under your accounts in 48 hours. For creators who want to self-deploy, the Sovereign Blueprint at $47 covers both stack options with full source code and step-by-step configuration guides. See both options at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
